title: GS1 / GS1 Digital Link

official_sources.source: GS1 Digital Link Standard: URI Syntax
facts: New implementations express GTIN as 14 digits.
Canonical reference GS1 Digital Link URIs use HTTPS and id.gs1.org.
GS1 Digital Link can connect GS1 identifiers to online information and services.
GS1 Digital Link URI Syntax current version is 1.7.0.

implementation_constraints: Do not treat Keshavarz20 SKU as GTIN.
A checksum-valid number is not proof that GS1 assigned it.
Only source-verified GTINs may produce live Digital Link mappings.
